description: Finds in-stock padel gear at Padel USA other than a racket fit: shoes, balls, bags, overgrips, accessories, bundles (and rackets by name or brand). Returns up to 6 items with price, available sizes/options with their variant_id, and links. For racket recommendations use find_racket instead.

query.description: Optional words such as a brand or model, e.g. "Babolat" or "Jet Premura".

size.description: US shoe size, e.g. "10" or "10.5". Only items in stock in that size are returned.

name: search_products
title: Search Padel USA gear
